info.description:
Import this collection, pick the "MediStock - Production (Render)" environment, then run it with the Collection Runner.

49 requests covering:
  01 Auth and login (success for 4 roles, 401 x2, 400)
  02 Role-based access matrix across admin / pharmacist / staff / supplier
  03 One happy-path route per module, including JSON and CSV responses
  04 404 and method-level role errors

Tokens are stored automatically after a successful login, and the collection pre-request script fetches any missing token so folders can be run individually.

Demo password for all seeded accounts: Password@123
